answer.book: Promptuarii iconum insigniorum a seculo hominum (Lyon, Rouillé, 1578-1581), a portrait book in two parts, each a run of named portraits with a biography, plus front matter, an appendix of antique and later portraits, and two alphabetical indexes; the individual portrait entries are unnumbered and are not listed here, so only the structural divisions are given.
